description: This is a Java source file for a Spring MVC controller class named ManufacturerController. It manages CRUD operations for Manufacturer entities in an admin web interface, handling listing, creating, editing, saving, deleting manufacturers, and supporting pagination via AJAX.

classes.name: ManufacturerController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing Manufacturer entities in admin interface.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list manufacturers page.

methods.name: createManufacturer
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for creating a new manufacturer.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for editing an existing manufacturer by ID.

methods.name: displayManufacturer
methods.description: Prepares and displays manufacturer details form for create or edit mode.

methods.name: saveManufacturer
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a manufacturer entity.

methods.name: pageManufacturers
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to return a paginated list of manufacturers in JSON.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to delete a manufacturer by ID.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu state in the model for UI highlighting.
